from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    for name, arr in [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only nonpositive values")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("all input matrices must have the same shape")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    # Compute normalized future-token weights
    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)                       # offsets
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)                # raw weights
    weights = raw / raw.sum()                            # normalized weights

    # Compute weighted future-token loss for each candidate
    def weighted_loss(logp_matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return -np.sum(weights * logp_matrix, axis=1)   # shape (n_candidates,)

    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_empty = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Margins and keep mask
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
